question: Which two actions should be performed before upgrading the infrastructure and firmware of multiple UCS blades? (Choose two.)
options: Get Full State and All Configuration backup files before beginning the upgrade.
Verify if the bootflash on the fabric interconnects in the Cisco UCS has at least 10% available space.
Verify if the bootflash on the fabric interconnects in the Cisco UCS has at least 15% available space.
Enable Smart Call Home feature during the firmware upgrade process.
Run the Check Conformance feature to verify that all your components are running the compatible firmware version after the upgrade.
